General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging

What is This Part?
This is the LHD Parking Brake Cable #1 for the Suzuki Samurai.
This cable goes from the Hand Brake Lever to the Rear Brake Drum.
Note: There is also an Emergency Brake Cable #2 which is sold separately.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Parking Brake Cable #1 (LHD)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
